messages:
nina: Filing here  CI log leak found: a recent pipeline artifact (build-4187) included `VAULT_TOKEN` in plain text. Detected by cred-scan. Affects vault path `secret/data/ci/service/keys`. Need immediate token revoke, audit snapshot, and KMS rewrap if ciphertext used. @tom @dina please triage.

sec-bot: Detector: cred-scan v2.7 -> matched pattern VAULT_TOKEN in artifact build-4187. First seen 2026-02-12T09:12:03Z. Link: https://ci.internal/builds/4187/artifacts/trace.txt :rotating_light:

tom: On it. Quick confirm: token looked like a long-living accessor (policy=ci-read, ttl=720h). We'll revoke and rotate. I'll snapshot audit and revoke accessor.

dina: Also check whether any Cloud KMS wrapped ciphertexts were uploaded to partner buckets. If CI used gcloud kms to encrypt secrets at build time, we need to rewrap via KMS and remove the old key binding.

eng-platform: Recommend immediate steps: 1) snapshot Vault audit (enable file+json if not on), 2) revoke token accessor, 3) rotate transit key wrapping the KV, 4) remove KMS encrypt/decrypt role from the CI service account.

nina: Please post exact commands when you run them so we have an audit timeline.

tom: Running snapshot now. Command: `sudo cp /var/log/vault-audit.log /tmp/audit-ci-1746001111.log && aws s3 cp /tmp/audit-ci-1746001111.log s3://sec-forensics/1746001111/` -> started.

auditor-bot: Vault audit device check: file-audit enabled (path=/var/log/vault-audit.log), json enabled. Retention: 90d.

tom: Revoke accessor: `vault token revoke -accessor h1:abcdef1234567890` -> OK. Also ran `vault lease revoke -prefix secret/data/ci/service/keys` to be safe. Returned revoked 4 leases.

dina: I'm listing GCS uploads for the build and scanning ciphertext headers. Command I ran: `gsutil ls gs://ci-artifacts/builds/4187/** | xargs -n1 gsutil cp -n` and then grepping for KMS-key-id. Found 1 object encrypted with projects/myproj/locations/global/keyRings/ci/cryptoKeys/ci-wrap-key.

eng-platform: Removing KMS IAM binding now for CI SA to prevent any further on-machine wrapping: `gcloud kms keys remove-iam-policy-binding projects/myproj/locations/global/keyRings/ci/cryptoKeys/ci-wrap-key --member='serviceAccount:ci-runner@myproj.iam.gserviceaccount.com' --role='roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter'` -> change applied. Logged in audit.

sre-oncall: We should rotate the KMS key material (create new key version and re-encrypt). I'll create a new key version and run rewrap pipeline: `gcloud kms keys versions create --key=ci-wrap-key --location=global --keyring=ci` then use `gcloud kms encrypt`/`decrypt` workstream or use our rewrap worker.

nina: For Vault: rewrap via transit? We have KV stored as ciphertext (wrapped using transit). Command: `vault write -f transit/rewrap/ci-wrap` -> queue job. Tom please confirm after job finishes.

tom: Rewrap submitted -> job completed successfully (rewrapped 12 entries) at 09:28Z.

dina: After KMS rekey and transit rewrap, we need to rotate any downstream tokens that were minted using that secret (CI deploy keys, deployer service accounts). I've kicked off a CI sweep to look for created GCE service accounts and long-lived GHA tokens.

auditor-bot: Audit note added: revocation events, KMS IAM removal, rewrap job timestamps saved to ticket.

nina: RBAC followups: patch the CI namespace to remove legacy clusterRoleBinding that allowed CI runner to impersonate SA with kms access. Proposed patch: `kubectl delete clusterrolebinding ci-legacy-impersonate` then create scoped RoleBinding instead. Also set `automountServiceAccountToken: false` on runners.

eng-platform: We'll apply the RBAC patch in 10m and add an OPA gate to block new clusterRoleBinding creation in prod orgs. Patch snippet: `kubectl patch sa ci-runner -n ci -p '{"automountServiceAccountToken": false}'` and `kubectl delete clusterrolebinding ci-legacy-impersonate`.

tom: Final detection grep: `grep -R "secret/data/ci/service/keys" /var/log/vault-audit.log | tail -20` -> shows 2 reads from that token before revoke. No reads after revoke. Artifacts and audit uploaded to s3://sec-forensics/1746001111/.

sre-oncall: I will also add an alert rule to look for VAULT_TOKEN in artifacts moving forward and block uploads that match the regex via the artifact store lifecycle hook.

dina: Partner/integrations note: if any external partners pulled derived secrets, we must notify and rotate external creds. I've pinged partner security.

nina: Action items recorded: 1) credential sweep for CI artifacts, 2) rotate affected keys + rewrap + KMS rekey, 3) RBAC cleanup (delete legacy clusterrolebinding + automount disable), 4) add artifact scanning block + alert. I'll file tickets and assign.

sec-bot: Incident closed in channel pending partner confirmation and ticket creation. Incident ticket ID: INC-20260212-891. :white_check_mark:
